gap: No result ChatGPT got states a measured end-to-end key latency for the Lofree Flow 2: Igor's Lab measured an average of about 11.3 ms with NVIDIA LDAT.
standout_why: I tried both cited rival pages, RTINGS 'Best Keyboards For Typing' and Tom's Guide 'best mechanical keyboards'. The fetch tool returned only their navigation and menus, so I can't confirm what they say. RTINGS review and compare pages (result #11 is a Keychron V5 Max vs NuPhy Halo75 V2 compare) usually carry latency, operating force, pre-travel and typing-noise results, so rivals probably already have part of this angle for the Keychron and NuPhy boards. The Lofree Flow 2 is our lead product and none of ChatGPT's results cover it, so a named latency figure for it is new. But latency matters little to someone shopping for typing.
decides: It doesn't decide the pick. For typing, typing noise, operating force and pre-travel are what count, and I couldn't open a named source for those on any candidate. The Igor's Lab figure only shows the Flow 2 has no latency problem. PCWorld's figure (20% battery used over a three-day test) loosely supports Lofree's battery claim but doesn't separate the Flow 2 from the other candidates.

findings.note: By Karsten Rabeneck-Ketme, published 2025-11-14 (modified 2025-11-16). Tested on the Flow 2 100 (full-size). The bottom line says 'around 11 milliseconds.' The page doesn't say which connection mode or which switch (Pulse or Void) the latency run used. I assume the 84-key model shares the controller, but that is my inference and the page doesn't state it.

findings.note: By Mattias Inghe, published 2026-09-23, tested August 2026, rated 3/5. Tested on the Flow 2 100 (Kailh Void silent switches per its spec list), not the 84. PCWorld gives no backlight setting or hours of use, so this can't be turned into hours. The review repeats Lofree's claim of about 120 h of active use, or 14 h at maximum backlight. Its price for the Flow 2 100 is $169.

unsourced: RTINGS measured operating force, pre-travel, total travel and typing-noise results for the Keychron Q5 Max/Q1 Max, NuPhy Halo75 V2, NuPhy Air75 V3, Lofree Flow 2 and Keychron K8 Max: I opened rtings.com/keyboard/reviews/keychron/q5-max-q1-max-q2-max-etc, /nuphy/air75-v3-air65-v3-air100-v3, /lofree/flow-2-mechanical and the Flow 2 vs Air75 V3 compare page. Each returned only navigation, and the results look member-locked or script-rendered. rtings.com/keyboard/reviews/keychron/q1-max returned 404.

Named measurements for the Logitech MX Mechanical Mini, Lofree Flow Lite 2 84 and Keychron K8 Max: I ran out of the tool budget before searching for these.
